messages:
maya: Hey all — Sam says his nephew is popping by at 3pm with a foldable e-scooter and a medium courier box. Any preferred temporary storage spots? Also: are we okay printing a temp visitor badge on arrival?
frontdesk: Hi Maya — we can stash the scooter in the side storage alcove by the bike racks (folded). But if it has a removable battery we need the courier to confirm it's not lithium-ion installed.
maya: Good call. Sam will ask — it's an EU-model so likely non-removable but small. If it's non-removable, is the alcove still ok?
frontdesk: It's fine as long as battery is powered off and scooter is folded. We'll put a caution tag on it. If courier flag says "battery inside", we may need it in the secure locker instead.
quentin: Quick heads-up — the large locker next to the mailroom is free today until 5pm. I can reserve it and leave the key at the desk.
sanjana: @quentin huge thanks if you can — could you add a note for the front desk with the locker code?
quentin: Yep I’ll leave a sticky on the desk and DM the code to frontdesk.
badge-bot: temp badge printed for visitor name: "Visitor - Sam's Guest" (expires 4:30pm).
maya: Nice, thanks @badge-bot & @quentin. One more thing — seating: the nephew's coming in for 45 mins. Do we want to offer the sunny couch or the conference bench?
frontdesk: Sunny couch is fine, it's quieter today. I'll put a "reserved" sign.
sanjana: Sunny couch ✅ — Also can someone grab a trash bag for the courier box if they need to open it?
quentin: I’ll bring a box cutter and some tape.
maya: Perfect. Sam said he might also drop off a small plant for the lobby — it's marked fragile. If it arrives, please put it on the low shelf by reception (label with "Sam — plant").
frontdesk: Will do. Thx for the heads-up.
sanjana: Poll: coffee or water for visitor? :coffee: :droplet:
maya: :coffee: please
quentin: :droplet: (hydration first)
frontdesk: I’ll offer both.
maya: Thanks team — I’ll update Sam and ask him to confirm battery type.
quentin: Leaving locker note now, ping me if anything changes.
frontdesk: See you at 3pm — will print the badge and tag the scooter if needed.
